description: Replace the Markdown of a page you own (requires an lp_ API key). The URL stays the same; every update is kept as a revision. Pass expected_version (from get_doc) to guard against overwriting someone else's changes — a conflict returns 409 with current_version.

expected_version.description: Optional optimistic-lock guard: the version you last read. Saves only if it still matches.

slug.description: The document slug — the path part of its https://lucid.page/<slug> URL.

title.description: Optional new title; omit to keep the current one.

name: update_doc

revision_hash.description: Content hash of the new revision

version.description: Monotonic save counter; pass as expected_version next time

title: Update a published document
